gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-duru-sans: A line where the paper shows through between letters gives Wallpoet its bold, commanding look, while Duru Sans stays modern and clean. Give Duru Sans a generous size so its wide openings can breathe.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-fresca: Fresca's curves match its stems exactly, with no calligraphic thinning. Wallpoet's bold, commanding heading takes the lead, so the sans body can sit at a modest size without losing its open counters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans reads crisp and level, its strokes holding one width. Paragraphs in it should move along smoothly, while Wallpoet, bold and commanding, breaks its lines with gaps where the paper shows through.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-gafata: Gafata sets a tall band of lowercase under short ascenders, with a wide-eyed e, beneath Wallpoet's bold, commanding heading. Over pages, this plain sans reads contemporary and steady.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-geist: Clean and quiet, Geist keeps a level beat with no accents of weight, while Wallpoet shouts in bold, commanding display letters. Wallpoet grabs attention; Geist hands over words as solid blocks.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-georama: Approachable Georama pulls its c apart like a bracelet, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. And against bold, commanding Wallpoet, its text should glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-gidole: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with a line that lets the paper show through between letters. Gidole then draws neon-tube strokes of one width, terminals parted like open scissor blades.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-golos-text: Loud meets tidy: Wallpoet commands with high-rising lowercase while Golos Text fills the line with one width of stroke. Wallpoet stands out; this sans-serif keeps its x-height full and friendly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachable, with small letters nearly capital height. Wallpoet does bold, commanding display lettering, while this plain sans keeps a clear gap where each c ends.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-heebo: Wallpoet climbs high and commands the page, while Heebo's curves stop short instead of closing in on themselves. Body text in Heebo would work well at a moderate, comfortable size.
